name: Hamilton

queries.query: Hamilton Ontario official parcel GIS property parcels open data ArcGIS feature service City of Hamilton
queries.result: First-party City of Hamilton pages identified the Open Data catalogue and interactive mapping context. ArcGIS item metadata attributed the Hamilton Assessment Parcel feature service to the City of Hamilton; anonymous layer metadata and a bounded geometry query succeeded.
queries.scope: Find a public parcel layer and request only safe source ID plus geometry/CRS metadata.

queries.query: Hamilton Ontario données officielles parcelles cadastrales SIG lots propriété service cartographique municipal
queries.result: French-language discovery did not identify a distinct French municipal parcel portal; the official City of Hamilton English Open Data and mapping sources remained the relevant first-party routes. The same public ArcGIS parcel service was then checked anonymously.
queries.scope: Independent local-language discovery; no owner, address, title, tax, contact, or account fields requested.

source.name: Hamilton Assessment Parcel
source.operator: City of Hamilton (ArcGIS item accessInformation); parcel source described as Teranet data received February 9, 2024
source.outputCrs: EPSG:4326 for bounded query; layer native metadata EPSG:102100/latestWkid 3857
source.nativeIdEvidence: Layer metadata declares OBJECTID as the system-maintained unique ID and object ID field.
source.safeFieldPolicy: No raw source attribute set retained; only canonical native OBJECTID and geometry were retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City of Hamilton official open-data/mapping context and the public Hamilton Assessment Parcel service; one small WGS84 envelope was queried.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public parcel polygons and stable OBJECTID identities were verified in the tested envelope. Citywide completeness, freshness beyond service metadata, and cadastral/legal title coverage were not asserted.

remainingUncertainty: The bounded response reported exceededTransferLimit=true, so it is a sample rather than a completeness test. The exact WUP point was not shifted and no citywide absence or completeness inference is made.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not a parcel-derived coordinate.
registryBasis: The City of Hamilton's official Open Data page identifies its public data catalogue; the public ArcGIS item is attributed to City of Hamilton and exposes the Hamilton Assessment Parcel layer with anonymous metadata and geometry query access.
